Four test files exercise `findEnclosingSgSymbols`. Each one imports it from `../src/sg.js` and calls it directly:

- `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts`
- `tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`

The function is also called indirectly by the `sg` tool (`src/sg.ts:415`), but only when `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1`. The only test that sets that variable and also runs the `sg` tool is `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`, which is already in the list. `tests/context-hygiene-debug-tool.test.ts` sets the variable too, but it never runs `sg`.

To rerun them:
`npx vitest run tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`
